independence.basis: Different auditor session; read the committed English, context and Vietnamese bytes directly. Translator receipt claims were not used as audit evidence. git status --porcelain=v1 was empty after the audit.

evidence.semantic_review: Read all 341 English/Vietnamese pairs and all 341 English context entries side by side across the 12 scoped namespaces; checked accuracy, idiom, bạn/plain-verb register, sentence case, provider/settings terminology and existing vi catalogue usage.

keys_and_order.command: Python json.loads over each scoped en/vi/context file; compared list(en) == list(vi), key sets and context key sets.
keys_and_order.actual_output: 12/12 namespaces same_order=True and context_exact=True; total en=341, vi=341, context=341.

icu_structure.command: Node @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser AST walk comparing argument names/types, number skeletons, select arms, tags and plural structure, allowing only the vi CLDR removal of the English 'one' category.
icu_structure.actual_output: Locale-normalized ICU structure mismatches: 0 []; Select branches structurally checked: 3. Negative control with count renamed to total was detected: true.

cldr_and_formatted_samples.command: Node Intl.PluralRules('vi') and IntlMessageFormat against the audited vi bytes.
cldr_and_formatted_samples.actual_output: Inputs 0,1,2,3,5,11,21,100,1.5 all returned only 'other'. ui.providers.provider_detail.code_expiry formatted 1 => 'Mã hết hạn sau 1 phút'; 2 => 'Mã hết hạn sau 2 phút'; 1234 => 'Mã hết hạn sau 1234 phút'. ui.chat.pickers.stop.confirm formatted 1 => 'Dừng 1 phiên ngay'; 2 => 'Dừng 2 phiên ngay'; 1234 => 'Dừng 1234 phiên ngay'. more_providers_and with providers=A,count=1234 => 'Nhà cung cấp khác: A và 1234 nhà cung cấp nữa'. Number skeleton ::group-off remained ungrouped.

pseudo_localization.command: Parsed every vi message with captureLocation=true, doubled Unicode letters only in literal AST spans, then formatted en, vi and pseudo-vi with sample arguments through IntlMessageFormat.
pseudo_localization.actual_output: Messages: 341; pseudo-expanded: 340 (the remaining ui.providers.provider_grid.row_action is placeholder-only); format runs: 1023; format errors: 0. This is static/parser evidence, not rendered evidence.

nfc_diacritics_typography.command: Python unicodedata.normalize('NFC'), combining-mark U+0300..U+036f scan, boundary/control-whitespace comparison and literal typography scan over all 341 vi values.
nfc_diacritics_typography.actual_output: NFC/combining/boundary/control issues: 0 []. No ASCII '...', exclamation marks or non-NFC text found. Open-syllable forms observed use the guide's khóa/hóa/hủy/xóa convention. Curly quotes, spaced em dashes and single ellipses were preserved where used.

static_overflow.method: Compared JavaScript string lengths en/vi and reviewed the 26 heuristic candidates (vi > en*1.35 and at least 8 characters longer) against roles/length notes. These are static triage results only; no fit claim is made.

findings.current: Dừng {count, plural, other {{count, number, ::group-off} phiên}} ngay
findings.proposed: Dừng {count, plural, =1 {phiên này} other {{count, number, ::group-off} phiên}} ngay
